locations.secondary_policy: Keep London only for strong matches

exclude: pure brand/product/performance/growth marketing when the role is not strategy, analytics, commercial planning, category, GTM or transformation led
pure CRM/campaign operations when CRM is the core job rather than part of a broader commercial excellence, customer strategy, analytics or transformation role
preferred: strategic account management when consultative/analytical rather than pure sales
closed_rule: Never mark CLOSED unless the relevant official source was successfully verified in the current run.
source_priority: official ATS or official career site
LinkedIn and aggregators for discovery only
cost_policy: No paid external services or APIs

seniority_policy.6_plus_mandatory: normally exclude unless an unusually strong and credible fit justifies review

fit_thresholds.policy: Milan/Rome use 70; London/Luxembourg use 80 for standard roles. Priority-company exhaustive reporting rules for Amazon and Mastercard override normal top-N/threshold suppression after scope/experience review.

purpose: discover vacancies missed by primary ATS/mapping

jd_mapping_policy.policy: A title containing Manager, Senior, Lead, Head or Director must never be rejected by title alone. Read the full JD first. Base inclusion on mandatory years, actual responsibility scope, people-management requirements and role level. Manager titles with <=5 mandatory years or junior/early-mid scope remain eligible.

semantic_analysis_execution.github_role: enumerate inventory, preserve state, generate semantic queue and audit
semantic_analysis_execution.chatgpt_role: open/read full JD, map mandatory vs preferred requirements, assess real seniority and fit, persist decision
semantic_analysis_execution.rule: A run may not claim semantic completeness while semantic_queue contains pending records.
semantic_analysis_execution.title_metadata_rule: ChatGPT may close a role from title/company/location/metadata only when it is clearly impossible to reach the fit threshold.
semantic_analysis_execution.full_jd_rule: Any plausibly relevant role requires full official-JD mapping; business-compatible Manager/Senior/Lead always requires full-JD review and is never excluded by title.

surface_registry_policy.standard_roles: Do not repeat unchanged STILL_OPEN roles after they have been surfaced; re-surface only NEW, materially UPDATED, newly reportable, or explicitly requested.
surface_registry_policy.priority_roles: Amazon in JW2 and Mastercard in JW1 are re-surfaced every daily run while open and in scope.
surface_registry_policy.write_order: Persist semantic decision first; write surfaced history only for roles actually included in the user-visible output; then re-run/sync state when possible.

priority: mapping level FULL but current coverage PARTIAL
partial_remediation_policy.method: Attempt a safer structured/public ATS endpoint, pagination contract, count reconciliation or official first-party inventory parser. Never upgrade coverage merely by changing a label.
partial_remediation_policy.verified_rule: Promote to VERIFIED only when the current run can exhaust and reconcile the official inventory.
partial_remediation_policy.logging: Keep unresolved portals PARTIAL with the concrete technical reason so the next run can retry or remap them.

daily_semantic_completion_policy.objective: A daily Job Watch run must fully process the current actionable delta without being blocked by the historical semantic backlog.
actionable_delta: all NEW vacancies in target geography
all open Amazon and Mastercard priority vacancies that are new/updated or not yet semantically decided
previously open never-surfaced roles that are selected for today's backlog tranche

backlog_policy.minimum_progress_rule: After the current delta is complete, use remaining run capacity to reduce the oldest/highest-value backlog. Never re-read unchanged already-decided JD fingerprints.

daily_semantic_completion_policy.daily_complete_rule: DAILY_COMPLETE when every actionable-delta item for the run is decided/reconciled and output persistence succeeds, even if historical backlog remains. Report backlog separately as BACKLOG_REMAINING.
daily_semantic_completion_policy.full_backlog_complete_rule: FULL_SEMANTIC_COMPLETE only when semantic queues contain no pending historical records.

company_self_improvement_policy.purpose: Continuously discover high-value employers outside the current watchlist without polluting the permanent company universe.
discovery_sources: official career sites reached from discovered roles
recurring high-fit employers surfaced by LinkedIn/Indeed/Glassdoor/other aggregators
candidate_requirements: at least one official open role in a target geography matching the user's business/strategy/finance profile
official careers/job source must be identifiable
company_self_improvement_policy.promotion_rule: Promote to the appropriate JW batch when either (A) at least 2 distinct validated in-scope roles are observed within 30 days, or (B) one Milan/Rome role has expected fit >=85 and the employer has attractive compensation/career relevance. London-only companies require stronger evidence and expected fit >=85.
company_self_improvement_policy.promotion_action: On promotion, add the company to companies_job_watch_v2.json and the correct job_watch_batches.json batch, then create/update an ATS mapping. If ATS cannot yet be mapped safely, keep the company staged and continue discovery.
company_self_improvement_policy.pruning_rule: Remove or archive a candidate after 60 days with no further relevant validated role.
no_auto_promotion_if: compensation/career value is clearly below current targets

reporting_efficiency_policy.priority_company_reporting: For Amazon and Mastercard, keep exhaustive inventory and semantic coverage in state files, but user-visible daily output should emphasize NEW/UPDATED/newly-decided high-fit roles plus concise counts. Do not print hundreds of unchanged STILL_OPEN rows unless explicitly requested.
reporting_efficiency_policy.standard_company_reporting: Show NEW, materially UPDATED, AUTONOMOUS_DELTA, newly reportable and never-surfaced relevant roles. Suppress unchanged already-surfaced STILL_OPEN roles.
reporting_efficiency_policy.audit_footer: Always include concise per-batch coverage, daily delta completeness, historical backlog remaining, FAILED/NOT_CHECKED counts, and new-company discovery changes.

persistence_batching_policy.rule: Accumulate semantic decisions and surfaced-history changes across all four JW modules during the daily run, then persist them in as few GitHub commits as practical before a single semantic sync/audit cycle.
persistence_batching_policy.reason: Avoid triggering one sync workflow per vacancy or per file and reduce GitHub Actions churn/race opportunities.
persistence_batching_policy.exception: If a critical write must be persisted before continuing, write it immediately; otherwise batch.
persistence_batching_policy.atomic_commit_rule: Persist semantic_decisions, surfaced history, and job_watch_run_state for all affected JW modules in one Git commit via Git data/tree operations when connector capabilities allow. This prevents multiple push-triggered semantic-sync runs and preserves one coherent GPT run.
persistence_batching_policy.post_write_verification: After persistence, verify the resulting semantic-sync workflow and re-read job_watch_healthcheck.json. Do not report completion until repository evidence confirms the write and healthcheck.

protected_categories_policy.scope: All JW1/JW2/JW3/JW4 vacancies and autonomous discoveries, not only Amazon.
protected_categories_policy.principle: A reference to L.68/99 / Protected Categories / Categorie Protette is never by itself an exclusion. Classification must use the full official JD and distinguish preference, requirement/reservation and inclusive invitation wording.

classification.NO: No L.68/99 / protected-category wording detected in the official vacancy.
classification.PREFERRED: Protected-category membership is explicitly preferred/preferably intended, but is not a Basic Qualification/must-have. Analyze and score normally; do not materially penalize fit solely for this wording.
classification.REQUIRED: Protected-category membership is explicitly required/must-have or appears as an eligibility requirement in Basic Qualifications/application requirements.
classification.RESERVED: The vacancy explicitly says it is reserved/exclusively available to protected-category candidates.
classification.INVITED: Inclusive wording encourages/invites protected-category candidates to apply without stating a requirement or explicit preference. Analyze and score normally.
classification.AMBIGUOUS: Protected-category wording exists but the official JD does not clearly establish preferred vs required/reserved vs invitation. Require full-JD review and flag the ambiguity.

detection_guardrails: A protected-category phrase in the title alone must never be interpreted as REQUIRED or RESERVED.
Phrases such as 'preferably intended for candidates belonging to Protected Categories' / 'preferibilmente rivolta' map to PREFERRED unless a contradictory must-have appears elsewhere.
Phrases such as 'candidates belonging to protected categories are encouraged to apply' / 'si invitano a candidarsi' map to INVITED unless a contradictory must-have appears elsewhere.
If L.68/99 membership appears in Basic Qualifications, explicit must-have/eligibility text, or the application form as required, map to REQUIRED unless the vacancy explicitly says RESERVED/exclusive.
Never advise false disclosure or bypassing an eligibility question.

non_l68_routing.PREFERRED: Eligible for normal fit analysis and reporting if above threshold.
non_l68_routing.INVITED: Eligible for normal fit analysis and reporting if above threshold.
non_l68_routing.REQUIRED: Normally not reportable as a candidable opportunity unless eligibility is explicitly confirmed; may be retained as an informational/ambiguous record.
non_l68_routing.RESERVED: Normally not reportable as a candidable opportunity unless eligibility is explicitly confirmed.
non_l68_routing.AMBIGUOUS: Do not assume eligibility either way; surface only when otherwise strong and clearly flag that eligibility needs confirmation.

protected_categories_policy.candidate_privacy_rule: Do not persist or infer the user's disability/protected-category status. For REQUIRED/RESERVED roles, treat eligibility as unconfirmed unless the user explicitly confirms it in the current relevant context.

ordinary_twin_search.priority: If a substantially equivalent ordinary requisition is currently open on the official career site/ATS, prefer and report the ordinary requisition, link the protected requisition as protected_twin, and do not recommend applying to both when they are substantively the same opportunity. Historical/closed twins may be noted as context but must not be marked ordinary_twin_found.
ordinary_twin_search.no_twin_rule: If no ordinary twin exists, PREFERRED/INVITED roles may be reported normally when fit is above threshold; REQUIRED/RESERVED follow eligibility routing.
ordinary_twin_search.reverse_link: When an active ordinary twin is found, persist the protected requisition on the ordinary record as protected_twin_job_id/protected_twin_url so reporting can route the user to the ordinary application while preserving the relationship.

application_priority: PREFERRED protected-category requisition when no ordinary twin exists and fit is high
INVITED protected-category requisition when otherwise in scope and fit is high
do not recommend REQUIRED/RESERVED unless eligibility is explicitly confirmed

compact_notes.PREFERRED: L68 PREFERRED — candidatura possibile anche non L68
compact_notes.INVITED: L68 INVITED — wording inclusivo, nessun requisito rilevato
compact_notes.REQUIRED: L68 REQUIRED — eleggibilità da confermare; non suggerire candidatura se requisito non posseduto
compact_notes.RESERVED: L68 RESERVED — eleggibilità da confermare; non suggerire candidatura se requisito non posseduto
compact_notes.AMBIGUOUS: L68 AMBIGUOUS — verificare eleggibilità nella JD/form

amazon_role_family_policy.purpose: For Amazon, do not restrict discovery to generic Strategy/Business Analyst titles. Retain the business job families empirically compatible with the candidate's consulting, retail/FMCG, commercial analytics, e-commerce, pricing/margin/inventory/sourcing and stakeholder-management background, then score the full JD semantically.

Business Development / Amazon Business: Commercial Manager / Growth Manager when analytical and non-pure-sales

secondary_target_families: In-Stock / Instock / Buying / Procurement roles when commercial rather than specialist supply-chain
Customer Success / Customer Solutions roles with strategic account ownership
Amazon Ads account roles only when the JD is consultative/analytical and not primarily quota-led sales
semantic_guardrails: Job title is a discovery signal, never a fit decision. Read the full JD for every plausibly relevant Amazon business role.
Do not auto-exclude Account Manager merely because it contains 'account': distinguish consultative marketplace/vendor/account-growth ownership from pure quota-carrying sales.
Do not auto-exclude Vendor Manager, Program Manager, Product Manager, Senior, Lead or Manager by title; apply the global mandatory-experience and actual-scope policy.

For Business Analyst roles, distinguish business analytics/decision-support roles from SQL/Python-heavy analytics-engineering profiles; mandatory technical gaps affect fit but title alone does not exclude.
For Product Manager roles, prioritize business/product strategy, customer, marketplace and commercial ownership; deprioritize deeply technical PM roles requiring engineering background.

For Vendor/Brand/Marketplace roles, give positive evidence weight to retail/FMCG, commercial strategy, pricing, profitability, e-commerce, sourcing/inventory, analytical decision support and senior stakeholder exposure.

Pure sales, account executive, advertising-sales, engineering, data engineering and highly technical specialist roles remain excluded unless the full JD clearly shows a materially different business scope.
amazon_role_family_policy.reporting_rule: Amazon remains a priority company. Preserve exhaustive Amazon business-role inventory in state, but surface user-visible roles according to semantic fit, location threshold, seniority and delta/reporting rules.

adjacent_role_family_policy.purpose: Prevent false negatives caused by company-specific titles that describe strategy, analytics, commercial ownership or transformation without using the words Strategy or Business Analyst.

Category / Marketplace / Retail: Vendor / Brand / Buying roles with analytical commercial ownership
Customer / Partnerships: Client / Customer Solutions when consultative and analytical

semantic_guardrails: A title containing Marketing or CRM is not a hard exclusion when it also contains a strong business signal such as Trade Marketing, Commercial Excellence, Category, RGM/NRM, Pricing/Revenue Management, Business/Customer Insights, Strategy, GTM/RTM, Commercial Planning or Sales Strategy & Operations. Send it to full semantic review.

Trade Marketing is eligible when the JD is primarily channel/category/GTM/commercial analytics, planning or investment effectiveness; exclude brand/campaign execution-heavy roles that lack broader business ownership.

Sales Strategy & Operations / Sales Operations is eligible when the work centers on planning, analytics, process design, productivity, coverage, incentives or business performance; exclude quota-carrying frontline sales.

Category/Marketplace titles are eligible when they combine assortment, pricing, profitability, seller/vendor/customer growth, analytics or strategic planning. Procurement-only specialist roles require separate fit assessment.
Revenue Management titles must be read in context: FMCG/consumer/marketplace pricing and profitability are high-priority; hotel/airline yield-management specialisms are not automatically equivalent.
Client/Account titles require full-JD distinction between strategic/consultative account ownership and pure new-business sales.
The job title is a discovery signal only. Final inclusion still depends on mandatory experience, domain requirements, scope, compensation/career value and full-JD semantic fit.

run_certification_policy.source_snapshot_rule: The GPT run manifest must match current_jobs_jw1..jw4 generated_at exactly. JW2 must also match amazon_target_check.json checked_at.
required_per_batch: semantic_delta_complete=true only after all actionable NEW/UPDATED/AUTONOMOUS_DELTA items are decided
autonomous_search_complete=true only after independent autonomous research has actually been executed for the batch
priority_check_complete=true for JW1/Mastercard and JW2/Amazon; JW3/JW4 use true as not-applicable completion
autonomous_delta_count must equal autonomous_validated_count after first-party validation/reconciliation
run_certification_policy.reporting_rule: Never state DAILY_COMPLETE from assistant memory, collector success, or audit text alone. Read the persisted healthcheck generated after the GPT persistence/sync cycle.

github_connector_read_policy.large_file_rule: A connector response with content='' is not evidence that a repository file is empty. Check repository metadata size/SHA and use blob reads or line-range reads for large files before diagnosing corruption.
github_connector_read_policy.corruption_rule: Declare a file corrupted only after cross-checking repository size/SHA, parseability or blob content, commit/diff evidence, and related audit/state files.
github_connector_read_policy.action_rule: For run status, inspect the actual GitHub Actions run conclusion and relevant job logs, not only committed output files.
